scope: Source-bound review of the trained compact chart geometry routes, using the existing training-prefix inventory and normalization metadata. No raw data reload, formula recomputation, model call or training.
limits: Unique native training rows in each route are not identical parent populations and may appear repeatedly in model windows. Nonzero frequency and variable support do not establish correctness or utility. Local/MTF parameter differences are intentional source configuration, not proof of a defect. The 32 positions per timeframe missing from the earlier numeric index remain independently unqualified.
